title: Jogen Chowdhury: refugee to master painter
text: Born into a landed family in Faridpur in pre-Partition East Bengal, he suffered a great reversal of fortune and became a post-Partition refugee in Calcutta. Drawing on memories of the kantha embroidery and alpona floor art of Bengal's village women, he built a personal modern idiom. The tribute calls him a 'hard optimist' and a 'dreamer of institutions'.
use: For 'A thorn is a changed bud', 'Best lessons are learnt through bitter experiences' and 'magical in the mundane' (art from folk floor drawings).

title: The farmer who copied a friend's strawberries
text: In Manauli, Sonipat, Arun Chauhan switched from paddy to sweet corn after visiting a friend's strawberry farm. His village moved 70% of its land to sweet corn and vegetables, formed an FPO and now sells directly to e-commerce firms.
use: For 'The cost of being wrong is less than the cost of doing nothing', 'Ideas with large consequences are simple' and 'A ship in harbour is safe'.

title: Angkrish Raghuvanshi's maiden century
text: Out for 92 on debut three years ago, then dropped, the 22-year-old admitted doubting whether he would ever score a first-class hundred. He finally made 114 for Mumbai.
use: For 'Best lessons are learnt through bitter experiences' and 'Ships sink because of water that gets into them' (self-doubt as the real threat).

title: Ageing with dignity: Keralam's elder-rights law
text: Keralam's new law gives senior citizens the right to age at home, recognises living wills, and regulates care homes and caregivers. The Chief Minister called it a realisation that 'our world is changing'.
use: For 'Life is a long journey between human being and being humane', 'The years teach much...' and 'Hand that rocks the cradle' (care work).
